Material & Details
Material: 55% Silk, 45% Rayon
Weight: 45 Momme‌
Pattern: Traditional Chinese Embroidery
Width: 110cm
Length: Sold by yard
Texture: Soft, breathable, lightweight
Craft: Fine embroidery stitching

Material & Craftsmanship
This premium brocade fabric is made from a high-quality silk blend, combining the natural sheen and softness of mulberry silk with the durability and structure of modern fibers. Woven with advanced jacquard techniques, the surface features elegant Chinese landscape patterns such as traditional pavilions, mountains, gardens, and flowing scenery. The fabric offers a smooth hand feel, graceful drape, and excellent wrinkle resistance, making it ideal for garments that require both refined texture and long-lasting wear. It is a perfect balance of traditional artistry and modern textile performance.

Style & Aesthetic Appeal
Inspired by classical Eastern culture, this fabric blends timeless Chinese elegance with contemporary fashion sensibility. The intricate woven motifs and harmonious color palette give the textile a luxurious yet wearable look, making it perfect for modern cheongsam dresses, Asian-inspired jackets, tailored suits, stage costumes, and couture designs. Under different lighting, the jacquard patterns subtly shimmer, adding depth and dimension to finished garments. Whether for fashion collections, cultural performances, or photography styling, this brocade elevates every creation with authentic oriental charm.

Uses & Target Customers
This silk blend brocade is ideal for fashion designers, qipao studios, costume makers, and DIY sewing enthusiasts who appreciate fine craftsmanship and cultural storytelling. It is suitable for making dresses, coats, suits, performance outfits, and statement accessories, as well as for home décor projects such as cushion covers, table runners, and decorative backdrops. Perfect for both small-batch custom orders and premium fashion lines, this fabric brings elegance, heritage, and artistic value to every project.

Perfect for: Children’s dresses, shirts, doll clothes, casual blouses, and DIY sewing projects.

Please note: Colors may vary slightly due to screen settings. Ordering a sample is recommended if color matching is critical.

Bring elegance and bohemian charm to your sewing and design projects with this all-over hollow out paisley lace fabric. Made with a fine polyester mesh base and delicately embroidered with cotton thread, this fabric combines the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester mesh. Its intricate paisley (cashew flower) crochet pattern creates a dimensional, lightweight, and breathable fabric, ideal for fashion and home décor.

The openwork lace allows light to pass through, giving your creations a refined, airy look. Perfect for bridal overlays, veils, dresses, blouses, curtains, table runners, and other decorative projects, this lace fabric adds timeless beauty and sophistication.

Details
Material: Polyester mesh base + cotton embroidery thread
Width: ≈ 51.2"
Colors: Off-white, Black
Style: Boho, Paisley / Cashew Flower, Hollow Out Lace
Weight & Feel: Lightweight, breathable, soft touch yet durable

Highlights
All-over hollow out lace — elegant, delicate, breathable
Classic paisley (cashew flower) embroidery with cotton thread
Ideal for bridal overlays, veils, fashion apparel, and home décor
Soft hand-feel and durable structure for long-lasting use

Cut & Use Tips
Fabric is usually cut in one continuous length when possible.
Hand wash or use a gentle machine cycle. Avoid long soaking. Wash dark and light colors separately.
Dyed with eco-friendly plant-based dyes. Line dry in the shade, avoid direct sunlight.
Avoid harsh brushes or vigorous rubbing. Store in a clean, dry place for easy care and long-lasting use.

Size & Measurement
Fabric sold in half-yard increments. Example: quantity 2 = 1 yard total. Multiple quantities cut as continuous length whenever possible.
Measured by hand; slight variations may occur due to tension or stretching. Please refer to the actual product.

Notes
Color Difference: Photos may vary due to lighting and display screens. Different batches may have subtle differences.
Loose Threads: Fabric is unhemmed, so minor loose threads may appear; they will disappear after sewing.
Creases: Fabric folded for shipping may show creases.
